summary: Memory mapping for large DICOM stacks

message.content: My 2048-slice volume crashes with MemoryError on my 16 GB laptop. How do I load it?

content.text: Use np.memmap so slices are paged from disk instead of loaded into RAM.

Here is the diff:
```diff
--- a/src/dicom_io.py
+++ b/src/dicom_io.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-x
+y
```

message.content: <system-reminder>noise</system-reminder>That worked, I decided to keep memmap for all samples. Loading now takes 40 s instead of crashing.
